domain_prompt:
We are building a benchmark of ontologies covering the following domains:
- people and social networks (FOAF)
- general web content markup (schema.org)
- document and resource metadata (Dublin Core Terms)
- e-commerce offers and products (GoodRelations)
- desktop files and documents (NEPOMUK File Ontology)
- organizational structures (W3C Organization Ontology)
- film and video annotation (Cinelab)
- scientific workflow plans (EP-Plan)
- electric mobility and charging infrastructure (Urban IoT Electric Mobility)
- weather patterns (Weather Patterns)

Name ONE everyday domain for a new ontology that is unrelated to all of the domains above. Reply with the domain name only (one or two words).
